- Practical utility: For programming and measuring progress, submaximal testing and performance-based measures (e.g., 3–5RM estimated 1RM formulas, RPE-based autoregulation, multiple-repetition strength tests, or functional performance tests) provide safe, valid estimates of maximal strength without the risks of a true 1RM.

Safer alternatives to a 1RM test
- 3–5RM concentric test (preferred): Have her perform a 3RM or 5RM on key lifts (squat, deadlift, bench) with good technique. Use validated prediction equations to estimate 1RM. - Velocity- or RPE-based estimates: Use an RPE scale (e.g., if an athlete can squat 5 reps at a given load at RPE 8, you can estimate 1RM) or, if available, a linear position transducer to estimate 1RM from bar speed.
- Submaximal load test with fixed rep target (e.g., 8RM): Safer still — test an 8RM and use an equation to estimate 1RM.
- Performance/functional tests: Measure improvements using timed carries, number of repetitions at a submaximal load, vertical/standing long jump substitutes (low-impact), or a 3–5 minute rowing power test — useful for metabolic and strength progress without maximal loading.

Below is the complete 12‑week programme (2026-06-01 to 2026-08-23) with every adjustment you requested rolled in: pelvic-health restrictions, two specified flare windows (2026‑07‑10 to 2026‑07‑13 and 2026‑08‑04 to 2026‑08‑07), menstrual flow‑day rules, anti‑inflammatory nutrition, an aerobic base plan, an intensified Phase 2, one low‑impact HIIT‑style metabolic day (once/week), one plyometric day (low‑impact progression), and a safe end‑of‑phase testing plan (3RM estimate rather than true 1RM). I’ve mapped session types into weekly templates and flagged where to swap to Flow/Flare variants on the flare-window dates and on any flow days.

Key constraints repeated
- On all menstrual flow days and during flare windows (2026‑07‑10–13 and 2026‑08‑04–07): NO HIIT, NO heavy Valsalva, NO jumping. Use Flow/Flare variant sessions.
- Avoid breath‑holding/Valsalva always; cue diaphragmatic breathing and exhale on exertion.
- Client should be medically cleared. Stop and refer to clinician if pelvic pain increases >2/10 or new concerning symptoms occur.

Overview by phase
- Phase 1 — Weeks 1–4 (2026-06-01 to 06-28): Foundation. Strength 3x/week, cardio 3x/week (mostly steady-state), mobility 1x/week. Low impact; conservative loads.
- Phase 2 — Weeks 5–8 (2026-06-29 to 07-26): Build with increased intensity. Strength 3x/week (higher loads), cardio 3x/week (add one low-moderate interval HIIT-style session), plus 1 plyometric day (low-impact) per week. Week 6 includes flare window 2026‑07‑10–13 — modify those days.
- Phase 3 — Weeks 9–12 (2026-07-27 to 08-23): Consolidate and peak/assess. Maintain strength, aerobic base, keep plyometrics and HIIT once/week; taper in Week 12 and do testing (3RM estimate) on a non-flow, non-flare day.

Weekly structure (standard)
- Strength A (Squat-dominant)
- Strength B (Hinge / pull)
- Strength C (Upper push + core + light power)
- Cardio: 3 sessions/week (2 steady-state, 1 interval HIIT-style low-impact)
- Plyometric day: once/week in Phases 2 & 3 (low-impact only; skip on flow/flare)
- Mobility/Pelvic health session: once/week (breathing, pelvic floor down-training, thoracic & hip mobility)
- Rest days: at least 1 full rest day/week

Flow/Flare variant (apply on any session on menstrual flow days OR dates in flare windows)
- Replace scheduled Strength/HIIT/Plyo sessions with:
  - 20–30 min easy pool walking / stationary bike / brisk walk (RPE 2–3)
  - 2–3 rounds light bodyweight/band circuit: Glute bridges 15, Band rows 12, Side‑lying clams 12 each, Bird-dog 10 each
  - 8–10 min diaphragmatic breathing + pelvic-floor relaxation cues
- Avoid heavy loads, intervals, jumps, and breath‑holding.

Progression principles used
- Strength: RPE target 6–8 in Phase 1, push to 7–8 in Phase 2, maintain in Phase 3. Use load increases when rep ranges hit comfortably two sessions in a row (+2.5–5% upper body, +5–10% lower).
- Cardio: increase time ~10% every 1–2 weeks; intervals progress in duration/number not by making them all‑out.
- Plyometrics: low-impact progression from small hops and med-ball throws to small bounds only if symptom-free.
- Testing: end of Week 12 do 3RM testing protocol (not true 1RM). Test on a non-flow, non-flare day, with medical clearance.
